note: What each appearance-consistent run of the video is, judged from a contact sheet of its frames. A run whose tiles show more than one product is labelled `skip`: a contaminated reference is worse than a missing one, because it teaches the catalog that one product looks like another. Two splits are labelled, a coarse one at similarity 0.75 and a fine one at 0.86: the coarse split keeps long clean runs whole, the fine one recovers the clean parts of runs the coarse split could not separate. Their outputs are unioned by video frame.
